entities.summary: Yuan Yang is a British Labour Party politician, economist and journalist serving as Member of Parliament for Earley and Woodley since 2024. Yang is the first Chinese-born Briton to be elected to the UK Parliament, and the third of Chinese ethnicity after Alan Mak and Sarah Owen.
